items.title: Delta-Vega Hedging with Deep Reinforcement Learning: From Simulation to Reality
items.summary_raw: Hedging an option portfolio with the underlying asset alone leaves the position exposed to changes in volatility, which can be managed by trading another derivative, at higher transaction costs. We propose a deep reinforcement learning approach to hedge both price and volatility risk under discrete-time trading and transaction costs, by trading the underlying asset and a second, longer-dated option. We train the agent with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) on synthetic data from a stochastic volatility model, and restrict its state to quantities observable in the market, so that the policy le
items.summary_cn: 针对仅用标的资产对冲会暴露于波动率风险的问题，本文提出用深度强化学习同时对冲价格与波动率风险：智能体在离散交易和交易成本约束下，交易标的资产加一只更远期期权。策略用 PPO 在随机波动率模型的合成数据上训练，且状态变量严格限定为市场可观测量，使策略可落地到真实市场。
items.why_cn: Delta-Vega 联合对冲是期权做市的核心痛点，这篇把 DRL 从仿真推向可交易现实的思路值得期权量化团队直接借鉴。

items.title: How LLM Agents Reshape Financial Knowledge Graphs: A Survey
items.summary_raw: Financial knowledge graphs (KGs) link information across sources to support risk assessment, investment research, asset recommendations, and forecasting. Large language models (LLMs) help build these graphs by extracting relationships from text and matching entities across records. Yet a workflow may still prescribe which sources to consult and which checks to run. If the chosen sources lack relevant evidence, even accurate extraction can leave a financial question unanswered. LLM agents can adapt the workflow as evidence emerges. They use the graph and earlier findings to decide where to look
items.summary_cn: 一篇关于 LLM 智能体如何重塑金融知识图谱的综述。传统金融 KG 工作流需预先指定查哪些数据源、跑哪些校验，一旦源数据缺乏证据，再精准的抽取也无法回答问题；而 LLM Agent 能依据图谱与已有发现动态决定下一步检索方向，自适应调整工作流。
items.why_cn: 知识图谱是基本面量化和风控的基础设施，Agent 化的图谱构建范式直接影响研究自动化流水线的架构选型。

items.title: Distance from the Truth: Why Fragmented Merchant Underwriting Misses Risk, and What Source-Attributable Evidence Changes
items.summary_raw: Merchant underwriting becomes vulnerable when evidence is evaluated without enough visibility into its source, freshness, relationship to the applicant, or meaning for the proposed activity. Individually favorable checks do not necessarily establish that the same business is operating the merchant account, that its representative may bind it, or that its settlement instructions are authorized. We describe three failure modes of fragmented underwriting: distance from the source, the gap between a decision and the evidence needed to justify it; the correlation gap, in which material relationship
items.summary_cn: 本文剖析商户准入审核中「证据与来源脱节」的风险：单项核查结果良好，并不代表运营账户的确实是同一家公司、其代表有权签约、或结算指令获得授权。作者归纳了碎片化审核的三类失效模式——与来源的距离、决策与证据间的差距、以及相关性鸿沟，并讨论来源可归因证据的改进作用。
items.why_cn: 对做支付、信贷类金融科技风控的交易者而言，这是理解「数据碎片化导致风险漏检」的系统化框架。

items.title: Graph-Informed Deep Factor Model for Statistical Arbitrage
items.summary_raw: Statistical arbitrage exploits temporary mispricings between similar assets in the cross-section of daily equity returns. We propose a nonlinear single-factor model, called a Graph-Informed Deep Factor (GIDF) model, whose per-stock loadings have cross-sectional dependence conditional on a latent network. The network captures cross-sectional return dependencies that remain after removing the dominant eigenmodes of the return correlation matrix, thereby providing a complementary representation of inter-asset relationships beyond the leading sources of systematic variation. It is reconstructed fr
items.summary_cn: 提出图信息深度因子（GIDF）模型用于统计套利：这是一个非线性单因子模型，每股载荷在潜在网络条件下具有截面依赖性。该网络捕捉剔除收益相关矩阵主特征模态后残余的截面依赖关系，为主流系统性因子之外提供互补的资产间关系刻画。
items.why_cn: 把图神经网络与因子模型结合做截面套利是当前热门方向，「剔除主成分后的残余网络」这一构造思路可直接用于改进中性化与配对选股。

items.title: [TauricResearch/TradingAgents] Release: v1.0.0
items.summary_raw: - TradingAgents: Towards Agentic Finance Research. ### Research - Agents: Equity Research, Macro Strategy, Quant Research and Risk Analysis research in parallel and report back. - Skills: sixteen built-in research methods, from an earnings review to a DCF valuation. - Your own agents and skills, as Markdown files. - Plan mode: review and revise a research plan before it runs. - Sources: every figu
items.summary_cn: 多智能体金融研究框架 TradingAgents 发布 v1.0.0 正式版。支持股票研究、宏观策略、量化研究、风险分析等多 Agent 并行工作，内置 16 种研究方法（从业绩点评到 DCF 估值），允许用户以 Markdown 文件自定义 Agent 与技能，并新增「计划模式」：研究计划执行前可先审阅修改，且每个数字都标注来源。
items.why_cn: 这是当前最受关注的开源金融 Agent 框架的正式版，计划模式与可溯源引用让它更接近生产可用的研究助手，值得跟踪评估接入投研流程。

items.title: RefMix: Expanding Endpoint Proposals for Diversity-Preserving Reward Fine-Tuning
items.summary_raw: Online forward matching aligns flow-based generative models by repeatedly generating, rewarding, and fitting model-produced endpoints. However, this behavior creates an on-policy feedback loop: as high-reward modes become increasingly favored, alternative modes become less likely to appear in subsequent training pools, progressively reducing visual diversity. We introduce RefMix, a reference-assisted endpoint proposal strategy that addresses this limitation by injecting alternative candidates into the training pool while retaining the original task reward and forward matching objective. In par
items.summary_cn: 在线前向匹配训练流式生成模型时存在在策略反馈循环：高奖励模式被不断强化，其他模式逐渐从训练池中消失，导致多样性坍缩。RefMix 通过向训练池注入参考辅助的候选端点来缓解这一问题，同时保留原有任务奖励与前向匹配目标。
items.why_cn: RLHF/奖励微调中的模式坍缩问题同样出现在用 RL 训练交易策略的场景，「多样性保持」的训练技巧可迁移到策略搜索与组合生成。

items.title: Time-consistency of cash-subadditive risk measures: The infimal cocycle property
items.summary_raw: We characterize the time-consistency of convex, cash-subadditive dynamic risk measures in terms of their minimal penalty. The dual variables are conditional sub-probability densities, which factorize across an intermediate date in many ways, according to how the discount is allocated to the two periods. We introduce an infimal cocycle property, in which the penalty is the infimum over all such factorizations, and show that it is equivalent to time-consistency, with the infimum attained. This holds on $L^\infty$ under continuity from below, and on $L^p$, $p<\infty$, without continuity assumptio
items.summary_cn: 本文用最小惩罚项刻画凸的、现金次可加动态风险测度的时间一致性。其对偶变量是条件次概率密度，可按贴现在两期之间的分配方式作多种分解；作者提出「下确界上循环性质」——惩罚项取所有分解的下确界，并证明其与时间一致性等价且下确界可达，在 L∞ 与 Lp 空间均成立。
items.why_cn: 动态风险测度的时间一致性是多期组合风险管理的理论基石，做动态 CVaR 类风控的研究者值得关注其最新刻画结果。

items.title: Rank-size analysis of optimal portfolio weights with a reverse-engineering application
items.summary_raw: This paper investigates the shape of optimal portfolio weights using rank-size analysis. We consider four portfolio selection models: Global Minimum-Variance (GMV), minimum-CVaR, Risk Parity (RP), and the Most Diversified Portfolio (MDP). For each model, we fit seven rank-size specifications to the sorted portfolio weights generated over rolling windows. To compare the fitted specifications, we combine standard goodness-of-fit measures with Cumulative Second-order $\varepsilon$-Stochastic Dominance, an $\varepsilon$-parameterized generalization of Second-order Stochastic Dominance that quantif
items.summary_cn: 用秩-规模分析研究最优组合权重的形态：针对全局最小方差、最小 CVaR、风险平价、最分散化组合四类模型，在滚动窗口生成的排序权重上拟合七种秩-规模分布，并结合拟合优度与「累积二阶 ε-随机占优」准则比较各设定，进而反向工程组合权重结构。
items.why_cn: 揭示了主流组合优化方法产出权重的普适分布形态，可用于快速校验组合权重的合理性及反推隐含风险模型。

items.title: Modelling and Calibration of Climate-Related Credit Risk Under the Emissions Trading System
items.summary_raw: Emission trading systems (ETSs) price a growing share of global emissions, and some of their caps are set to reach zero within the maturity of corporate debt. We develop a structural model in which firms choose their emissions from several energy sources under an anticipated carbon price, while the realized carbon price clears the carbon market of each sector-region cell, with a scenario-dependent demand shock and physical losses mitigated by adaptation. We show that the equilibrium carbon price exists, characterize when the cap binds, and derive the optimal emission of each firm in feedback f
items.summary_cn: 在碳排放交易体系（ETS）下构建气候相关信用风险的结构化模型：企业在预期碳价下从多种能源中选择排放水平，实际碳价由各行业-区域碳市场出清决定，含情景依赖的需求冲击与适应性措施缓解的物理损失。论文证明了均衡碳价的存在性，刻画了配额约束生效的条件，并以反馈形式给出企业最优排放决策。
items.why_cn: 碳价上限趋零已进入公司债期限范围，该模型为量化信用组合中的气候风险溢价提供了可校准的结构化框架。

items.title: Retirement Planning with Borrowing Constraints and Income Support
items.summary_raw: We study how pension income, its pledgeability, and government support that supplements effective consumption shape an irreversible retirement decision. In a continuous-time life-cycle model, a worker chooses consumption, risky investment, and the timing of retirement, subject to a tighter borrowing limit after retirement. When retirement reduces the utility value of a given level of effective consumption, immediate retirement can be optimal on a bounded wealth interval: a worker below the interval retires when wealth rises to its lower boundary, while a worker above it retires when wealth fal
items.summary_cn: 在连续时间生命周期模型中研究养老金收入、其可抵押性与政府补贴如何塑造不可逆的退休决策：个体在退休后面临更紧的借贷约束下选择消费、风险投资和退休时点。当退休降低给定消费水平的效用价值时，「立即退休」可能在某个有界财富区间上最优——财富升到区间下沿即退、跌到区间上沿也退。
items.why_cn: 对生命周期资产配置与养老目标产品设计有参考价值，其带约束的随机控制求解思路也可用于其他最优停时类金融问题。

items.title: The Information Content of News Embeddings
items.summary_raw: Does the predictive success of news embeddings reflect a better measure of news surprises or other sources of return predictability in text? We decompose news embeddings by content into event-category, firm-identity, and idiosyncratic components, and by timing into historical levels and current deviations. At short horizons, event categories account for most of the predictive power of embedding forecasts, and simple forecasts based on historical average returns after news in each event category outperform them. At longer horizons, firm information already present in earlier news coverage accou
items.summary_cn: 系统拆解新闻嵌入的收益预测力来源：按内容分解为事件类别、公司身份与特质成分，按时间分解为历史水平与当期偏离。结论颇具颠覆性——短 horizon 上预测力主要来自事件类别，且「按事件类别取历史平均收益」的简单预测反而优于嵌入模型；长 horizon 上则主要是旧新闻中已含的公司信息在起作用。
items.why_cn: 对正在用新闻嵌入/LLM 情绪因子做信号的团队是重要的证伪警示：嵌入的 alpha 可能只是事件类别效应的包装，需重新审视因子归因。

items.title: Large-Scale Streaming Portfolio Optimization with Pauli Correlation Encoding
items.summary_raw: Classical portfolio construction over large asset universes is a combinatorial selection problem that existing heuristics do not solve well at scale. Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE) addresses this by representing the underlying clustering problem with far fewer qubits than one per asset, and a prior study showed it is competitive with classical methods on a single historical snapshot. This paper moves beyond that static test to a streaming deployment, in which the correlation structure and the portfolio are both re-estimated on a rolling basis, as a live rebalancing system would actually oper
items.summary_cn: 大规模资产域的组合构建本质上是组合选择问题，经典启发式难以扩展。Pauli 相关编码（PCE）用远少于「每资产一量子比特」的量子比特数表示底层聚类问题；本文将其从单次快照测试推进到流式部署——相关结构与组合均滚动重估，模拟真实调仓系统的运行方式。
items.why_cn: 量子计算做组合优化首次进入「滚动实盘式」检验，是评估量子方法何时能真正用于大规模组合构建的重要基准。

items.title: Large deviations for integrated exponentials of Gaussian Volterra processes - application to variance options
items.summary_raw: We prove small-time large deviations for the normalised time integral of the exponential of a Gaussian Volterra process, and complement it with a central limit theorem and moderate deviations. As an application, we obtain short-maturity asymptotics for out-of-the-money and at-the-money variance options in rough volatility models, as well as implied volatility expansions which we validate numerically.
items.summary_cn: 证明了高斯 Volterra 过程指数的时间积分在小时间下的大偏差原理，并补充中心极限定理与中等偏差结果。应用上得到粗糙波动率模型下虚值与平值方差期权的短到期渐近公式，以及经验证数值有效的隐含波动率展开式。
items.why_cn: 粗糙波动率下的方差期权定价渐近结果，可直接用于波动率衍生品 Desk 的短端定价与校准加速。

items.title: Rough log-normal stochastic volatility with quadratic drift: second-moment stability and the martingale property under positive correlation
items.summary_raw: We extend the log-normal stochastic volatility model with quadratic drift to a fractional Volterra equation. The volatility has a unique global non-negative solution with finite moments on every finite horizon. With linear drift we derive the conditional first and second moments, expected integrated variance and conditional squared VIX. We give the exact threshold for a uniformly bounded second moment and the exponential growth rate above it. With positive quadratic damping the second moment is uniformly bounded for every admissible Hurst exponent and volatility of volatility. A separate bound
items.summary_cn: 将带二次漂移的对数正态随机波动率模型推广到分数阶 Volterra 方程框架。波动率过程存在唯一全局非负解且各有限时域矩有限；线性漂移下推出条件一二阶矩、期望积分方差与条件 VIX 平方，并给出二阶矩一致有界的精确阈值及超阈值后的指数增长率；正二次阻尼下二阶矩对任意 Hurst 指数与波动率的波动率均一致有界。
items.why_cn: 为粗糙波动率模型的稳定性边界给出精确刻画，使用 rough vol 做波动率建模时需要知道参数何时会引爆数值模拟。

items.title: MINE: A Training-Free Defense against Indirect Prompt Injection via Mutual Information and Embedding Variance
items.summary_raw: Existing defenses against indirect prompt injection in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) are inherently reactive: prompt-engineering methods are often overridden by the injected instructions, while supervised detectors must be retrained for each new attack style. We propose a different paradigm: defend by maximizing relevance, not by detecting attacks. Our method, MINE, is training-free and attack-agnostic, and it also serves as a query-conditioned reranker. To evaluate defenses under realistic conditions, we introduce LC-Inj-SQuAD, a long-context benchmark with an average of 4,032 words pe
items.summary_cn: 针对 RAG 中间接提示注入的现有防御皆属被动：提示词工程常被注入指令覆盖，有监督检测器又需针对每种新攻击重训。MINE 提出新范式——不检测攻击，而是最大化相关性：免训练、攻击无关，兼作查询条件重排器；同时发布平均 4032 词的长上下文基准 LC-Inj-SQuAD 用于真实条件评测。
items.why_cn: 用 LLM+RAG 做研报解读、新闻信号的团队必须正视提示注入风险，免训练防御方案落地成本最低。

items.title: Focus Only on What's Important: Training-Free Focus Maps for Frozen Vision Transformers in Long-Video Object Segmentation
items.summary_raw: Vision transformers are strong but costly image encoders for video object segmentation. Training-free token merging cuts compute uniformly across the frame, including on tracked objects. We give a frozen DINOv3 ViT inside a trained Cutie head a training-free focus map: full resolution where the segmenter expects its objects and coarser merging elsewhere. Protecting only the previous frame's mask works on short clips but fails on long videos, where fast motion pushes targets outside the margin and into background merging, locking in loss. Our policy instead takes the union of velocity-shifted a
items.summary_cn: 为冻结的 DINOv3 ViT 设计免训练焦点图用于长视频目标分割：在分割器预期目标所在区域保留全分辨率，其余区域做粗粒度 token 合并以节省算力。仅保护上一帧掩码在长视频中会因快速运动失效，新策略改为取速度平移区域的并集，避免目标被并入背景而锁定误差。
items.why_cn: 免训练的注意力/算力分配机制与时序预测中「自适应聚焦重要区间」的思想相通，对处理长序列的模型设计有启发。

items.title: LiDAR Intensity Reconstruction with Limited Real Data: An Architecture Benchmark under Fixed-Epoch Training
items.summary_raw: Physics-derived simulation can supplement scarce real-world LiDAR intensity measurements, but its effectiveness depends on the learning architecture and the amount of real training data available. We benchmark nine neural architectures for LiDAR intensity reconstruction from depth, semantic labels, incidence angle, and material reflectance, using real SemanticKITTI and synthetic VoxelScape range-image data. All models follow a fixed 20-epoch protocol; this controls the number of training passes, not the computational cost across architectures. We report mean absolute error (MAE), mean squared
items.summary_cn: 在真实数据稀缺场景下，用物理仿真补充 LiDAR 强度测量，其效果取决于学习架构与真实训练数据量。论文在固定 20 epoch 协议下对九种神经架构做基准测试，使用 SemanticKITTI 真实数据与 VoxelScape 合成数据，从深度、语义标签、入射角与材质反射率重建强度，报告 MAE、MSE 等指标。
items.why_cn: 「仿真数据补真实数据」的架构对比方法论，对量化中用合成数据增强训练集的实践有可迁移的实验设计参考。

items.title: InstructTTS-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Objective Instruction-Following TTS
items.summary_raw: Instruction-following text-to-speech (Instruct-TTS) renders a target transcript in the manner described by a free-form natural-language instruction, and a good rendition must succeed on three fronts at once: following the instruction, pronouncing the transcript correctly, and sounding natural. Reinforcement learning has become the standard way to post-train such generative models toward human preferences, and TTS systems increasingly adopt it. When the three objectives are optimized together under a single scalar reward, typically with group relative policy optimization (GRPO), training tends
items.summary_cn: 指令跟随 TTS 需同时满足遵循指令、发音正确、听感自然三项目标；用单一标量奖励（如 GRPO）联合优化时训练易失衡。InstructTTS-OPD 采用在策略蒸馏方法处理多目标指令跟随语音合成，缓解三目标联合优化时的失衡问题。
items.why_cn: 多目标 RL 的奖励失衡与交易智能体中收益-风险-成本多目标训练是同一类问题，在策略蒸馏的解法值得借鉴。

items.title: [TauricResearch/TradingAgents] Release: v1.0.1
items.summary_raw: ### Fixed - Plan mode: the PDF report shows the question you asked, with what you added while planning, instead of "Carry out the plan". - Reports: the report starts with the answer; progress notes written along the way are left out. - Price history: a one-year window that spans February 29 is no longer refused. - Correlation: returns over only three shared dates are refused instead of reported as
items.summary_cn: TradingAgents v1.0.1 修复版：计划模式的 PDF 报告现在显示用户原始问题及计划阶段的补充，而非笼统的「执行计划」；报告以答案开头并剔除过程性进度笔记；跨 2 月 29 日的一年期价格窗口不再被拒绝；仅三个共同交易日的相关性计算将被拒绝而非输出误导性结果。
items.why_cn: 这版修复体现了金融 Agent 工具在数据严谨性（闰日、样本不足的相关系数）上的工程细节，选型评估时应关注此类边界处理。

items.title: Last Week in AI #348 - IPO->Correction, new GPTs and Geminis, Nvidia’s Fate
items.source: Last Week in AI (替代 The Batch)
items.summary_raw: Anthropic's $81B IPO, AI stocks enter a correction, Huang resigns from Nvidia, Trump and Xi agree on military AI
items.summary_cn: AI 周报第 348 期要点：Anthropic 以 810 亿美元估值 IPO、AI 板块进入回调、黄仁勋从英伟达辞职、中美就军事 AI 达成协议等重大行业事件。
items.why_cn: AI 板块回调与龙头公司人事剧变直接影响 AI 主题持仓与相关量化因子的拥挤度，需纳入本周风险监控。
